title: Global ML Bar Stool — 33"H
body_html:
A minimalist bar-height stool that brings hospitality polish to any reception lounge or breakout bar.

The Global ML Bar Stool is a contemporary take on classic minimalist style, designed by Richard Eppstadt to coordinate with the full ML lounge, dining and sofa collection. Standing at bar height (33"H), it pairs an upholstered seat and back with a clean metal frame available in Black, Chrome, Brushed Chrome, Designer White or Tungsten. Specify it in COM or the full range of Global textiles and leathers, and count on Canadian-made construction backed by a Limited Lifetime Warranty.

Key features

  • Contemporary minimalist silhouette designed by Richard Eppstadt
  • Bar-height (33"H) stool that coordinates with the full ML lounge, dining and sofa range
  • Upholstered in COM or the full range of Global textiles and leathers
  • Frame available in Black, Chrome, Brushed Chrome, Designer White and Tungsten
  • Suited to reception areas, modern offices and hospitality settings
  • Made in Canada

Who it’s for

Reception lounges, cafe and breakout bars, and hospitality-style touchdown spaces in municipal, education and corporate environments.

Office Central and Brant Business Interiors are verified OECM partners, so Ontario’s public sector can buy without an open tender. Call 1-800-835-9565 for a quote.
